## Runs 6 + 7 — `sdh-spot-check` at D = 0: two Fermi surfaces at both carrier signs; ABCA disfavored

**Raw:** run 6 (`data/6`, electron n = +3.2×10¹², B 0→10 T) — clean SdH from ≲ 1 T, deep oscillations 3–7.5 T, then a large feature peaking ≈ 525 Ω at 8.7 T (low-ν QH regime). Run 7 (`data/7`, hole n = −1.2×10¹², 10→0.3 T ride-down) — oscillations from ~0.7 T, slower structure, R rising to ~575 Ω at 10 T. No rails (fs ≤ 0.12), leakage flat (run 7's TG median −103 pA is a Vtg-dependent offset, stable, well under trip).

**Electron (run 6, F_full = 33.1 T):** dominant tone **7.1 T** (onset below 0.3 T record edge, SNR 40) plus heavy-band content at **21–26 T** and a strong **≈ 30 T** peak ≈ the sum (7.1 + 22.9 = 30.0; also ≈ 4×7.1 — harmonic/sum ambiguity noted, dF ≈ 1.6–2.4 T). Light + heavy ≈ 29–30 T vs F_full 33.1 T — a ~10% deficit within the cal (n_offset) + resolution budget. **Two-band spectrum**; the step-2 model's ABAB pair (7.5 / 25.6 T) matches; the ABCA singleton (33.1 T alone, no light tone) does not — there is no standalone 33 T line and the 7.1 T tone dominates.

**Hole (run 7, F_full = 12.4 T):** two comparable tones **4.7 / 6.6 T** (sum 11.3 ≈ F_full; FFT B>1.5 shows 5.3 + 12.3 ≈ sum) — the near-CNP two-pocket regime the model expects for ABAB (5.3 / 7.1 T). ABCA (12.4 T, m* ≈ 1 mₑ) would be LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K *and* single-frequency — not what's seen.

**Read:** both signs show two-band SdH with sum ≈ F_full → **ABCA strongly disfavored; ABAB consistent; ABCB not yet excluded** (its monolayer-like + trilayer-like decomposition can mimic a light+heavy pair at single densities). The discriminator is the **density dependence** — frequency-vs-n partition and the LL gap/crossing pattern — i.e. the Landau fan (next step).

# Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (electron n = +3.2e12, hole n = -1.2e12), raw then FFT/onset
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_fft, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError, luttinger_frequency
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

IB = 10e-9  # A (100 MOhm bias resistor, sr1 drive)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7))
onsets = {}
for i, (rid, side, n12) in enumerate([(6, "electron", 3.2), (7, "hole", -1.2)]):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0 / IB
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    F_full = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    ax[i, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax[i, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[i, 0].set_ylabel("R_xx (Ohm)")
    ax[i, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} {side} n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (raw)")
    print(f"===== run {rid} ({side}, n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_full = {F_full:.1f} T) =====")
    try:
        so = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / IB); onsets[rid] = so
        print(so.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"sdh_onset failed: {e}")
    for blo, sty in [(1.5, "-"), (3.0, "--")]:
        m = B >= blo
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[m][:, None], B[m], nfft=4096, log=False)
        sp = spec[0]
        ax[i, 1].plot(freqs, sp / sp[freqs > 3].max(), sty, lw=0.8, label=f"B > {blo} T")
        sel = freqs > 3
        pk, _ = find_peaks(sp[sel], height=0.15 * sp[sel].max())
        fpk, hpk = freqs[sel][pk], sp[sel][pk]
        srt = np.argsort(hpk)[::-1][:5]
        print(f"  FFT B>{blo}: peaks (T, rel): " + ", ".join(f"{fpk[j]:.1f} ({hpk[j]/hpk[srt[0]]:.2f})" for j in srt))
    ax[i, 1].axvline(F_full, color="k", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"F_full = {F_full:.1f} T")
    ax[i, 1].set_xlim(0, 60); ax[i, 1].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[i, 1].set_ylabel("norm FFT mag")
    ax[i, 1].legend(fontsize=7); ax[i, 1].set_title(f"run {rid} SdH FFT in 1/B")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking-call measurement (plan step 4)

> **05:26** · landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25..+3.25e12 co-swept (Vtg,Vbg) 131 pts fast; B 0.4..10 T 60 mT 161 rows slow; sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS); ends 10 T, gates->0 · **ETA ~14:11** (≈8h45m)

Spot checks (runs 6–7, ana cell 15) show two-band SdH at both carrier signs with tone sums ≈ F_full — **ABCA disfavored, ABAB vs ABCB unresolved**. The discriminator is density dependence: the frequency-vs-n partition between light and heavy bands and the high-B Landau-level gap/crossing pattern. This fan measures R_xx(n, B) along the D = 0 line (run-5 calibration).

**Design.** Fast axis: (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along D = 0, n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² cm⁻², 131 pts (Δn = 3.46×10¹⁰ → ≥ 7 pts per Δν = 1 at 10 T; ν lines resolved above ~2–3 T). Slow axis: B 0.4 → 10 T ascending (magnet sits at 0; never re-traverse), 60 mT, 161 rows — 1/B Nyquist supports per-column FFT of all observed tones (≤ 35 T) above ~2 T. fast_delay 1.0 s (= run-5 gatemap; 3.3τ at τ = 0.3 s), slow_delay 2 s on top of the driver's 3 s field settle. sr1 fixed 200 µV (20 kΩ FS at 10 nA): SdH range 10–600 Ω well resolved; **accepted rail**: the ν = 0 CNP stripe may exceed 20 kΩ at high B — sr0 (drain current) covers the railed stripe, and the rail itself marks the gap.

**Coverage trades, stated.** Hole side ends at n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V validator, not a choice — full hole coverage would need a limit change, which is session-banned). Single D = 0 cut: gap-vs-D discrimination is a contingency step if the fan is ambiguous (plan step 6).

**Price:** 161 rows × (131 × 1.10 s/pt [run-5 actual] + 26 s ramp + ~9 s turnaround) ≈ 8.0 h + start-up → **8 h 45 m realistic**. Ends at **10 T** with gates ramped to 0.

**Checkpoints** (hera-watch armed): first rows ~12 min (rail/leak/level — cheapest kill); ~2 T (~1.5 h, structure forming, CNP stripe level); ~5 T (~4 h, interim map re-form + F(n) read); ~8 T (~6.5 h, gap fingerprint). Wash-out: sr1 railed across the line, leak trip, dead channel, or no n-dependent structure by 3 T.

**Preconditions** (asserted in-cell): T_sample 1.0–1.5 K, |B| < 0.02 T, V_si = 0, Keithley NPLC 1, PS heater on + output enabled, thermometry logfile fresh.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): D = 0 line, n -1.25 -> +3.25e12 (131 pts) fast x B 0.4 -> 10 T (60 mT, 161 rows) slow ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 131)           # 1e12 cm^-2 along D = 0; step 3.46e10
D_fan = 0.0
VV = np.array([calc_gate_voltages(n, D_fan, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"]) for n in n_vec])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = VV[:, 0], VV[:, 1]
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
print(f"fast line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 at D = {D_fan:+.2f} V/nm; "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} (margins {Vtg_vec.min()-TG_MIN:+.4f}/{TG_MAX-Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V), "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f}")

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.4, 10.0 + 1e-9, 0.06), 4)   # 161 rows, ascending (magnet at 0)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and len(B_vec) == 161

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02: fan ascends from 0.4), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.02 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: sr1 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA (SdH range 10-600 Ohm well resolved;
# the nu=0 CNP stripe may exceed FS at high B - accepted rail, sr0 drain current covers it).
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan: D = 0 (run-5 cal), n -1.25..+3.25e12 co-swept (Vtg,Vbg) 131 pts fast; "
                  "B 0.4..10 T 60 mT 161 rows slow; sr1 200 uV; fast_delay 1.0, slow_delay 2.0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 cm^-2, 131 pts (fast, co-swept k_tg+k_bg); '
              f'B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 60 mT, 161 rows (slow); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'sr1 200 uV; stacking-order fan after spot checks runs 6-7')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg (fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=2.0, fast_delay=1.0)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    # field stays where the sweep left it (10 T on completion) - never re-traverse without a plan.
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
